dishes.name: Mujadara
dishes.nameEn: Lentils and rice with crispy onions
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan.
dishes.technique: Lentils are par-cooked, then simmered with rice and cumin and topped with onions fried slowly in olive oil until deep brown and crisp.

sources.title: Mujadara (Lentils and Rice With Fried Onions) - NYT Cooking

dishes.name: Koshari
dishes.nameEn: Egyptian lentils, rice and pasta with spiced tomato sauce
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan.
dishes.technique: Lentils, rice and pasta are cooked separately and layered, then crowned with chickpeas, a vinegary garlic-tomato sauce and crispy fried onions.

sources.title: Koshari (Egyptian Lentils, Rice, and Pasta) - Serious Eats
Meera Sodha's vegan koshari - The Guardian

dishes.name: Ful medames
dishes.nameEn: Stewed fava beans with cumin, lemon and olive oil
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan.
dishes.technique: Cooked fava beans are warmed and partly mashed with garlic, cumin and lemon, then finished with plenty of olive oil and fresh toppings.

sources.title: Ful Mudammas (Egyptian Fava Beans) - Serious Eats
How to make the perfect ful medames - Felicity Cloake, The Guardian

dishes.name: Falafel wrap
dishes.nameEn: Chickpea fritters in flatbread with tahini
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan.
dishes.technique: Soaked raw chickpeas are ground with herbs and spices, shaped and deep-fried until crisp, then wrapped in pita with salad and tahini sauce.

dishes.name: Shakshuka
dishes.nameEn: Eggs poached in spiced tomato and pepper sauce
dishes.veganApproach: Replace the eggs with seasoned tofu set into wells in the simmering sauce.
dishes.technique: Peppers and onions are softened into a spiced tomato sauce, then eggs are cracked into wells and gently poached in the pan.

sources.title: Vegan Tofu Shakshuka - This Savory Vegan

dishes.name: Maqluba
dishes.nameEn: Upside-down rice with fried eggplant and cauliflower
dishes.veganApproach: Skip the meat and build the layers from fried eggplant, cauliflower and potatoes cooked in a spiced vegetable broth.
dishes.technique: Fried vegetables, meat and rice are layered in a pot, simmered in spiced broth and then flipped onto a platter as a tall cake.

dishes.name: Fattoush
dishes.nameEn: Levantine bread salad with sumac
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan.
dishes.technique: Toasted or fried pita shards are tossed with chopped crisp vegetables and herbs in a lemony sumac and olive-oil dressing just before serving.

dishes.name: Tabbouleh
dishes.nameEn: Parsley and bulgur salad with lemon
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan.
dishes.technique: Finely chopped parsley dominates, lightly bound with soaked fine bulgur, tomatoes and mint and dressed generously with lemon and olive oil.

dishes.name: Kousa mahshi
dishes.nameEn: Rice-stuffed zucchini in tomato broth
dishes.veganApproach: Fill the zucchini with a rice, tomato, onion and herb stuffing instead of minced meat.
dishes.technique: Hollowed squash is filled with a raw spiced rice stuffing and slowly simmered in a garlicky tomato broth until the rice is tender.

sources.title: Kousa Mahshi (Stuffed Zucchini) - Plant Based Folk

dishes.name: Warak enab
dishes.nameEn: Stuffed grape leaves with rice, herbs and lemon
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan.
dishes.technique: Grape leaves are rolled tightly around a herby rice and tomato filling, packed in a pot and simmered under a plate with lemon and olive oil.

sources.title: Vegetarian Stuffed Grape Leaf Rolls - Maureen Abood
Warak Enab (Lebanese Grape Leaves) - Plant Based Folk

dishes.name: Sayadieh
dishes.nameEn: Spiced fish with caramelized-onion rice
dishes.technique: Onions are caramelized almost black to color and flavor the stock, in which rice is cooked and served with fried fish and toasted nuts.

sources.title: Sayadieh: Lebanese-Style Fish and Rice - Hadia's Lebanese Cuisine

dishes.name: Samke harra
dishes.nameEn: Baked fish with chili, cilantro and tahini sauce
dishes.technique: Fish is baked and then covered with a spicy sauce of garlic, cilantro, chili and nuts loosened with lemony tahini.

sources.title: Spicy Fish (Samkeh Harra) - Mama's Lebanese Kitchen

dishes.name: Fattet hummus
dishes.nameEn: Chickpeas over crisp pita with garlicky yogurt-tahini
dishes.veganApproach: Use plant-based yogurt for the sauce and toast the pine nuts in olive oil instead of butter.
dishes.technique: Crisped pita is layered with warm chickpeas and their liquid, smothered in garlic yogurt-tahini sauce and topped with sizzling nuts.

sources.title: Fatteh (Spiced Chickpeas with Crispy Pita and Garlicky Yogurt) - The Mediterranean Dish

dishes.name: Kibbet laktin
dishes.nameEn: Baked pumpkin and bulgur kibbeh with chickpea and greens filling
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan.
dishes.technique: A dough of mashed pumpkin and fine bulgur is layered in a tray around a filling of onions, chickpeas and greens, scored and baked with olive oil.

dishes.name: Bamia
dishes.nameEn: Okra and tomato stew
dishes.veganApproach: Leave out the meat and simmer the okra in tomato with plenty of garlic and cilantro, as in the olive-oil bamia bi zeit.
dishes.technique: Okra is briefly seared to limit sliminess, then simmered in a garlicky tomato sauce finished with fried cilantro and lemon.

sources.title: Vegan Okra in Tomato Sauce (Bamia Bzeit) - Zaatar and Zaytoun

dishes.name: Maghmour
dishes.nameEn: Lebanese eggplant and chickpea moussaka
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan.
dishes.technique: Roasted or fried eggplant is cooked with chickpeas, onions and garlic in a thick tomato sauce and eaten warm or at room temperature with bread.

sources.title: Lebanese Vegan Moussaka - The Washington Post

dishes.name: Manakish
dishes.nameEn: Za'atar or cheese-topped flatbread
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan.
dishes.technique: Rounds of yeasted dough are dimpled, spread with a za'atar and olive-oil paste or with cheese, and baked very hot until blistered.

sources.title: Lebanese Manoushe Za'atar Flatbread - Maureen Abood

dishes.name: Shawarma
dishes.nameEn: Spiced shawarma wrap with garlic sauce and pickles
dishes.veganApproach: Marinate thinly sliced seitan or oyster mushrooms in shawarma spices and roast until crisp-edged before wrapping with garlic sauce and pickles.
dishes.technique: Thin slices of spice-marinated protein are cooked until charred at the edges and rolled in flatbread with garlic sauce, pickles and salad.

sources.title: Vegan Seitan Shawarma - One Arab Vegan

dishes.name: Adas bi hamod
dishes.nameEn: Lemony lentil soup with chard and potatoes
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan.
dishes.technique: Lentils are simmered with potato and shredded greens, then sharpened with plenty of lemon and a garlic-cilantro sauté.

sources.title: Shorbat Adas bil Hamod (Lentil Soup With Greens) - NYT Cooking
Lentil Soup (Adas bi Hamod) - Zaatar and Zaytoun
Adas bi Hamod - Every Little Crumb

dishes.name: Musakhan
dishes.nameEn: Sumac-roasted chicken and onions on taboon bread
dishes.veganApproach: Swap the chicken for seared portobello mushrooms or roasted cauliflower over the sumac onions.
dishes.technique: Mounds of onions are slowly cooked in olive oil with sumac, spread over bread with the roasted protein and baked until the bread soaks up the oil.

sources.title: Vegan Cauliflower Musakhan - One Arab Vegan

dishes.name: Sabich
dishes.nameEn: Pita with fried eggplant, egg, tahini and amba
dishes.veganApproach: Omit the egg and add extra hummus and boiled potato for heft.
dishes.technique: Salted eggplant slices are fried until creamy, then stuffed into pita with sliced egg, hummus, chopped salad, tahini and tangy mango amba.

dishes.name: Imam bayildi
dishes.nameEn: Olive-oil braised eggplant stuffed with onion and tomato
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan.
dishes.technique: Whole eggplants are fried or roasted, split and filled with onions, garlic and tomato stewed in olive oil, then braised and served at room temperature.

dishes.name: Pide
dishes.nameEn: Turkish boat-shaped flatbread with spinach and feta
dishes.veganApproach: Bind the spinach and onion filling with crumbled tofu seasoned with lemon and salt instead of feta and egg.
dishes.technique: Yeasted dough is stretched into boat shapes, filled with wilted spinach and white cheese, edges folded over and baked until golden.

sources.title: Turkish Flat Breads with Spinach, Feta and Peppers (Peynirli Pide) - Ozlem's Turkish Table
Spinach & cheese pide - BBC Good Food

dishes.name: Gozleme
dishes.nameEn: Griddled stuffed flatbread with spinach and cheese
dishes.veganApproach: Use the classic spiced potato and onion filling or herby spinach, brushing with olive oil instead of butter.
dishes.technique: Thin unleavened dough is rolled out, filled, folded and cooked on a hot griddle or sac, brushed with fat until blistered.

sources.title: Gozleme: Anatolian Flat Breads Stuffed with Spinach, Onion and Feta - Ozlem's Turkish Table

dishes.name: Lahmacun
dishes.nameEn: Thin flatbread with spiced minced topping
dishes.veganApproach: Replace the minced meat with a paste of cooked lentils and walnuts blended with tomato, peppers and red pepper paste.
dishes.technique: A very thin layer of finely minced spiced topping is spread over paper-thin dough and baked in a scorching oven, then rolled with parsley and lemon.

dishes.name: Menemen
dishes.nameEn: Turkish scrambled eggs with tomatoes and green peppers
dishes.veganApproach: Scramble crumbled firm tofu with a pinch of turmeric into the pepper and tomato base.
dishes.technique: Mild green peppers and grated tomatoes are softened into a juicy sauce before eggs are stirred through and barely set.

sources.title: How to cook the perfect menemen - Felicity Cloake, The Guardian

dishes.name: Karniyarik
dishes.nameEn: Split eggplants stuffed with a spiced filling
dishes.veganApproach: Fill the eggplants with spiced lentils cooked with onion, peppers and tomato instead of minced meat.
dishes.technique: Fried whole eggplants are slit open, packed with a sautéed spiced filling, topped with tomato and pepper and baked in a little sauce.

sources.title: Stuffed Aubergines with Lentils (Mercimekli Karniyarik) - Ozlem's Turkish Table
Karniyarik: Turkish Stuffed Aubergines (Vegan) - Sibel's Recipe

dishes.name: Mercimek corbasi
dishes.nameEn: Turkish red lentil soup
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan.
dishes.technique: Red lentils simmer with onion, carrot and potato until they collapse, then are blended smooth and finished with chili-infused oil and lemon.

sources.title: Turkish Lentil Soup - The Mediterranean Dish
Mercimek Çorbası (Turkish Lentil Soup) - Simply Recipes

dishes.name: Kisir
dishes.nameEn: Spicy bulgur salad with pepper paste and herbs
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan.
dishes.technique: Fine bulgur is soaked in hot water, kneaded with pepper and tomato pastes, then tossed with herbs, onions and a tangy pomegranate dressing.

sources.title: Spicy Bulgur Wheat Salad (Kisir) - Ozlem's Turkish Table
Turkish Bulgur Salad (Kisir) - Turkish Food Travel

dishes.name: Cig kofte
dishes.nameEn: Spiced bulgur kofte wrapped in lettuce or lavash
dishes.veganApproach: Make the meatless etsiz style, kneading fine bulgur with pepper pastes and spices until it binds, as it is commonly sold across Turkey today.
dishes.technique: Fine bulgur is kneaded at length with pepper paste, spices and onion until it softens and binds, then shaped and wrapped with herbs and lemon.

sources.title: Cig Kofte - Picnic on a Broom

dishes.name: Balik ekmek
dishes.nameEn: Istanbul grilled mackerel sandwich
dishes.technique: Mackerel fillets are griddled until crisp-skinned and stuffed into bread with sliced onion, lettuce and sumac, finished with lemon.

sources.title: Istanbul's Famous Mackerel Sandwiches - Bon Appétit

dishes.name: Kuru fasulye
dishes.nameEn: Turkish white beans in tomato and pepper sauce
dishes.veganApproach: Cook the etsiz (meatless) version with olive oil, onions and pepper paste for depth.
dishes.technique: Soaked white beans are simmered slowly with onions and tomato and pepper pastes until creamy, and traditionally eaten with rice pilaf.

sources.title: Kuru Fasulye (White Bean Stew) - Baking Hermann
Turkish Vegan White Bean Stew (Etsiz Kuru Fasulye) - Mom's Bites

dishes.name: Mercimek koftesi
dishes.nameEn: Red lentil and bulgur patties in lettuce cups
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan.
dishes.technique: Red lentils are cooked until thick, bulgur swells in their heat, and the mixture is kneaded with sautéed onion, pastes and herbs and shaped into finger-pressed patties.

sources.title: Mercimek Koftesi (Turkish Lentil Balls) - The Mediterranean Dish

dishes.name: Turlu
dishes.nameEn: Turkish mixed summer vegetable stew
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan.
dishes.technique: A medley of summer vegetables is layered with tomatoes and onions and slowly stewed in olive oil until meltingly tender.

sources.title: Mixed Vegetable Stew - Republic of Türkiye Ministry of Culture and Tourism

dishes.name: Hamsili pilav
dishes.nameEn: Black Sea rice baked in a shell of anchovies
dishes.technique: Fragrant pilaf with pine nuts and currants is packed into a dish lined with butterflied anchovies, covered with more fish, baked and turned out.

sources.title: Rice with Anchovy (Hamsili Pilav) - Republic of Türkiye Ministry of Culture and Tourism
Hamsili Pilav: Turkish Baked Rice & Anchovies - Turkey's For Life

dishes.name: Ghormeh sabzi
dishes.nameEn: Persian herb stew with kidney beans and dried lime
dishes.veganApproach: Leave out the lamb and let kidney beans, slow-fried herbs and dried lime carry the stew, adding mushrooms for extra body if wanted.
dishes.technique: A mountain of chopped herbs is fried slowly until dark and fragrant, then simmered for hours with beans and pierced dried limes.

sources.title: Meera Sodha's vegan Persian herb, lime and kidney bean stew - The Guardian
Khoresh Ghormeh Sabzi - Plant Based Persian

dishes.name: Fesenjan
dishes.nameEn: Walnut and pomegranate stew
dishes.veganApproach: Swap the poultry for roasted butternut squash or mushrooms simmered in the walnut and pomegranate sauce.
dishes.technique: Finely ground walnuts are toasted and simmered for a long time with pomegranate molasses until the oil rises and the sauce turns dark and glossy.

sources.title: Vegan Fesenjan: Butternut Squash, Walnut and Pomegranate Stew - Roxana's Kitchen

dishes.name: Khoresh bademjan
dishes.nameEn: Persian eggplant and tomato stew
dishes.veganApproach: Replace the meat with yellow split peas cooked in the tomato and turmeric base under the fried eggplant.
dishes.technique: Fried eggplant slices are laid over a tangy tomato and turmeric stew and gently simmered so they soak up the sauce without falling apart.

sources.title: Vegan Khoresh Bademjan (Persian Eggplant Stew) - Plant Based Persian

dishes.name: Kuku sabzi
dishes.nameEn: Persian herb frittata
dishes.technique: A huge volume of finely chopped herbs is bound with just enough egg and cooked slowly in a covered pan until set, green and fragrant.

sources.title: Kuku Sabzi (Persian Herb Frittata) - Unicorns in the Kitchen
Kuku Sabzi (Persian Herb Frittata) - NYT Cooking

dishes.name: Ash reshteh
dishes.nameEn: Persian bean, herb and noodle soup with kashk
dishes.veganApproach: Finish with a cashew cream or plant-based yogurt drizzle in place of kashk.
dishes.technique: Beans and lentils are simmered with masses of herbs and greens, thickened with thin noodles and topped with kashk, fried onions and mint oil.

sources.title: Ash Reshteh (Persian Noodle and Herb Soup) - Cooking with Ayeh
Ash Reshteh (Persian Greens, Bean and Noodle Soup) - NYT Cooking

dishes.name: Adas polo
dishes.nameEn: Persian lentil rice with dates and raisins
dishes.veganApproach: Steam the rice with olive oil instead of butter, which still gives a crisp tahdig.
dishes.technique: Par-boiled basmati is layered with cooked lentils and steamed until fluffy over a crispy tahdig, then topped with onions, dates and raisins sautéed with cinnamon.

sources.title: Adas Polo (Persian Rice and Lentils) - The Mediterranean Dish
Adas Polo ba Khorma (Persian Lentil Rice With Dates) - NYT Cooking

dishes.name: Sabzi polo ba mahi
dishes.nameEn: Herbed rice with crisp fried fish
dishes.technique: Par-boiled rice is steamed with a heap of chopped herbs over a crispy tahdig and served with turmeric-dusted pan-fried fish, traditionally for Nowruz.

sources.title: Sabzi Polo ba Mahi: Herbed Rice Pilaf with Fish - The Caspian Chef
Sabzi Polow ba Mahi - Los Angeles Times

dishes.name: Baghali polo
dishes.nameEn: Dill rice with fava beans
dishes.veganApproach: Serve the dill and fava bean rice on its own without the lamb, steamed with olive oil instead of butter.
dishes.technique: Par-boiled basmati is layered with skinned fava beans and plenty of dill, then steamed until fluffy over a golden tahdig and finished with saffron.

sources.title: Baghali Polo (Persian Dill Rice with Fava Beans) - The Mediterranean Dish
Baghali Polo (Persian Fava Bean Rice) - Cooking with Ayeh

dishes.name: Ghalieh mahi
dishes.nameEn: Southern Persian fish stew with tamarind and herbs
dishes.technique: Cilantro and fenugreek are fried with garlic and spices, simmered with tamarind into a sour sauce, and the fish is poached in it at the end.

sources.title: Ghalieh Mahi: Fish in a Tamarind and Herb Sauce - The Caspian Chef
Persian Cod With Herbs and Tamarind - NYT Cooking
Ghalieh Mahi (Spicy Tamarind Fish and Herb Stew) - The Washington Post

dishes.name: Lubia polo
dishes.nameEn: Persian rice with green beans and tomato
dishes.veganApproach: Skip the meat and let the green beans, onions and spiced tomato flavor the rice, adding lentils for protein if desired.
dishes.technique: Green beans and onions are cooked in spiced tomato paste, then layered with par-boiled basmati and steamed to form a crunchy tahdig.

sources.title: Lubia Polo (Persian Green Bean Rice) - Cooking with Ayeh
Vegan Lubia Polo (Persian Green Bean Rice) - The Iranian Vegan

dishes.name: Masgouf
dishes.nameEn: Iraqi butterflied fire-roasted carp
dishes.technique: Whole carp is split along the back, opened flat and slow-roasted beside an open wood fire, then served with tomato, onion and bread.

sources.title: It's the national dish that brought down a dictator - Los Angeles Times

dishes.name: Molokhia
dishes.nameEn: Egyptian jute mallow soup with garlic and coriander
dishes.veganApproach: Simmer the greens in a well-seasoned vegetable broth and fry the garlic and coriander tasha in olive oil instead of ghee.
dishes.technique: Finely minced jute mallow is barely simmered in broth and finished with a sizzling fry of garlic and coriander, served with rice or bread.

dishes.name: Machboos samak
dishes.nameEn: Gulf spiced fish and rice
dishes.technique: Spice-rubbed fish is fried, then rice is cooked in a broth of onions, tomatoes, dried lime and whole spices and served with the fish.

sources.title: Bahraini Fish Machboos - Fork and Salt

dishes.name: Vegetable tagine
dishes.nameEn: Moroccan spiced vegetable and chickpea stew
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan.
dishes.technique: Vegetables and chickpeas are braised slowly with onions, tomatoes and warm spices under a lid, so they steam in their own juices.

sources.title: Moroccan Vegetable Tagine - The Mediterranean Dish

dishes.name: Couscous with seven vegetables
dishes.nameEn: Moroccan couscous with seven vegetables
dishes.veganApproach: Leave out the meat, build the broth from the vegetables and spices and fluff the couscous with olive oil.
dishes.technique: Couscous is steamed several times over a simmering broth in which meat and seven vegetables cook, then mounded and topped with the vegetables and broth.

sources.title: Moroccan Couscous with Seven Vegetables - Taste of Maroc

dishes.name: Harira
dishes.nameEn: Moroccan tomato, lentil and chickpea soup
dishes.veganApproach: Omit the lamb and enrich the soup with extra lentils, chickpeas and a little vermicelli.
dishes.technique: Legumes simmer in a tomato and herb broth with ginger and cinnamon, and the soup is thickened at the end with a flour-water slurry.

sources.title: Harira (Moroccan Lentil and Chickpea Soup) - The Mediterranean Dish
Vegan Moroccan Harira Soup - Vegetarian Times

dishes.name: Fish tagine with chermoula
dishes.nameEn: Moroccan fish tagine with chermoula and vegetables
dishes.technique: Fish marinated in chermoula is laid over sliced potatoes, tomatoes and peppers and braised gently with a little water until just cooked.

sources.title: Moroccan Fish Tagine with Chermoula and Vegetables - Taste of Maroc
Moroccan Fish Tagine - America's Test Kitchen

dishes.name: Lablabi
dishes.nameEn: Tunisian chickpea soup over bread with harissa
dishes.veganApproach: Leave off the soft egg and top with extra capers, olives and olive oil.
dishes.technique: Chickpeas simmered in a garlicky cumin broth are ladled over torn stale bread and finished at the table with harissa, egg, lemon and oil.

sources.title: Tunisian spiced chickpea and bread soup (lablabi) - Ottolenghi

dishes.name: Loubia
dishes.nameEn: Moroccan white beans in spiced tomato sauce
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan.
dishes.technique: White beans are simmered in a tomato sauce seasoned with cumin, paprika and garlic until tender and the sauce is thick, then mopped up with bread.

sources.title: Moroccan Stewed White Beans (Loubia) - Taste of Maroc
Loubia (White Bean and Tomato Stew) - NYT Cooking
Loubia: Moroccan White Bean Tomato Stew - Plant Based Jess

dishes.name: Bissara
dishes.nameEn: Moroccan split fava bean soup with cumin and olive oil
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan.
dishes.technique: Split fava beans are simmered with garlic until they fall apart, pureed into a velvety soup and finished with cumin, paprika and a pool of olive oil.

sources.title: Bessara - Fava Bean Dip or Soup - Taste of Maroc
Bissara (Creamy Fava Bean Purée) - NYT Cooking

dishes.name: Couscous bil hout
dishes.nameEn: Tunisian fish couscous
dishes.technique: Couscous is steamed over a fiery tomato and harissa broth in which vegetables and then fish are cooked, and the grains are moistened with the broth before serving.

sources.title: Couscous Bel Hout (Tunisian Fish Couscous) - Mediterranean Menus

dishes.name: Sardine kefta tagine
dishes.nameEn: Moroccan sardine balls in spiced tomato sauce
dishes.technique: Boned sardines are minced with herbs and spices, rolled into balls and simmered in a spiced tomato sauce until just cooked.

sources.title: Moroccan Sardine Fish Balls in Tomato Sauce - Taste of Maroc
Moroccan Sardine Balls in Spicy Tomato Sauce - The Spruce Eats

dishes.name: Seafood pastilla
dishes.nameEn: Moroccan seafood pie in crisp pastry
dishes.technique: A chermoula-spiced filling of fish, seafood and vermicelli is wrapped in layers of thin warqa or phyllo and baked until crisp and golden.

sources.title: Moroccan Seafood Bastilla - Taste of Maroc

dishes.name: Kofta kebab
dishes.nameEn: Grilled spiced minced skewers
dishes.veganApproach: Shape a spiced chickpea and lentil mixture bound with breadcrumbs onto skewers and grill or bake until browned.
dishes.technique: Minced meat is kneaded with grated onion, herbs and spices, molded onto flat skewers and charred quickly over high heat.

sources.title: Turkish Style Vegan Kofte Kebabs - Connoisseurus Veg
Vegan Egyptian Kofta - Cooking With Jade
